# Included font licences and provenance

The included font families are DejaVu and Latin Modern. The WOFF files were converted from the upstream TTF/OTF files using fontTools without changing their internal naming. All 26 upstream binaries are included in `font-sources/` alongside notices. Preserve these files/notices when redistributing the handoff. The site serves the WOFFs locally; System Sans is supplied by the visitor's browser.

- DejaVu: see `original-source/fonts/DejaVu-LICENSE.txt` and `font-sources/DejaVu-LICENSE.txt`. The licence allows reproduction/distribution/use subject to retained notices and its font-name/sale restrictions.
- Latin Modern: see `font-sources/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt`, the upstream README, and the complete GUST/LPPL text in `original-source/fonts/LatinModern-LICENSE.txt`. Distribution and modification are permitted subject to those terms. The GUST notice recommends a different name for modified versions; do not remove or change author/font names casually. The original binaries are retained to accompany the format conversions.

No proprietary commercial webfont subscription or remote font CDN is used. These are font-specific licences; they do not assign a blanket third-party font licence to the application code.
